issues.where: crop A, dark sunspot below the arch; also visible in image-03.png crop P and image-07.png crop Q
issues.what: The surrounding granules stretch into long, smooth spokes that pinch into a nearly featureless black oval with a serrated edge. The abrupt change in texture scale makes the spot look like a radial warp.
issues.fix: Replace the radial stretch with irregular penumbral filaments of varied lengths and orientations. Retain fine texture in the umbra and break up the transition to normal granulation.

issues.where: foreground crops T through W; also visible in image-04.png crops S through V
issues.what: Large granules look like inflated metallic cushions, with blurred centers, deep dark grooves, and repeated comb-like striations on their glossy rims.
issues.fix: Reduce the apparent relief and gloss, vary the granule shapes and border profiles, and replace the repeated rim striations with finer, irregular luminance detail.

issues.where: crops P and Q, where the erupting loops meet the surface; also visible in image-02.png crop A
issues.what: The footpoints clip into solid white cores fringed by dense, pixel-like speckles with abrupt edges against the softer surface.
issues.fix: Preserve detail in the bright cores, antialias the finest filaments, and taper the scattered highlights into the surrounding granulation.

issues.where: crops G through I, along the distant limb; also visible in image-06.png crops H and I
issues.what: A nearly continuous row of similarly sized orange needles sits on a narrow bright strip, making the limb read as a bristled cutout.
issues.fix: Vary the density, angle, length, and opacity of the limb filaments, and blend their bases into the surface glow.

issues.where: lower third of the globe and the lower-left and lower-right prominences (crops S, T, U, V in image-16)
issues.what: the surface and prominences are smeared into directional streaks, like a motion or zoom blur; granulation turns into mush and the prominence loops are doubled and ghosted with no fine structure
issues.fix: re-render the lower hemisphere at full resolution with no blur pass; keep granulation crisp to the limb and give the prominences sharp filament detail

issues.where: near foreground terrain, bottom band (crops S, T, U, V, W in image-12)
issues.what: the granules read as glossy, airbrushed plastic blobs with streaky brush-like highlights and smeared edges; at native size the texture is soft with no real cell detail
issues.fix: replace with a sharper granulation texture with bright cell centres and dark intergranular lanes, matte emissive shading and no specular gloss

issues.where: around the two loop footpoints (crops G, O, Q in image-10/11)
issues.what: each footpoint sits on a visible oval patch with a ragged, noisy outline and a different texture from the surrounding surface; the edge of the patch is plain to see
issues.fix: blend the plage patch into the surface with a wide soft falloff and matching texture scale

issues.where: sunspot and penumbra, centre (crops A, P)
issues.what: the penumbra is a radial smear of stretched granules pointing to the spot, which looks like texture pinching toward a point rather than penumbral filaments; the umbra is a flat black hole
issues.fix: model the penumbra as fine radial filaments with a clear umbra/penumbra boundary and some umbral dots, and stop the base texture stretching toward the centre

issues.where: limb along the whole horizon (crops H, I, N, Q, R)
issues.what: the spicules are hair- or grass-like spikes of the same size sitting on a hard horizon line; they look like a fur shader and repeat evenly
issues.fix: make spicules finer, more varied and semi-transparent, fading into a soft chromosphere glow rather than a hard edge

issues.where: globe surface, mid disc (crops A, D, G, O, P)
issues.what: the granulation is soft and blotchy at native size, with an overall soft-painted look and inconsistent detail; sunspots are smudges
issues.fix: raise texture resolution and sharpen the mid-disc detail; add limb darkening consistent with the surface

issues.where: corona around the limb (crops B, F, J, K, N, Q)
issues.what: the coronal streamers are uniform white brush strokes that end abruptly in places and give a halo-like painted ring around the disc
issues.fix: vary streamer length and brightness and let them fade smoothly into the sky

issues.what: the loops are drawn as sparkler-like spark streaks with dots falling off them; they read as a particle effect more than plasma
issues.fix: make the loops coherent glowing flux tubes with fine strands instead of spark trails

issues.where: sky, upper corners (crops B, I, L)
issues.what: the nebula background is muddy brown and smudged, with some stars as soft blobs
issues.fix: use a cleaner star field with point-like stars and a subtler galactic band

issues.where: top limb crop L and right limb crop R
issues.what: corona rays are straight, evenly fanned shafts, like a radial streak filter
issues.fix: bend the rays and vary their length and brightness so they are not a uniform fan

issues.where: prominence loops in crops C and D
issues.what: filaments read as combed hair or flat ribbons with soft, even edges
issues.fix: break strand thickness and density so the loops do not look like alpha cards

issues.what: the same straight radial streaks wrap the disk and give the silhouette away
issues.fix: replace the uniform fan with irregular, braided streamers

issues.where: bottom limb crops U and V
issues.what: spicules sit like a comb on a smooth circular edge
issues.fix: roughen the photosphere silhouette and jitter the spicule lengths

issues.what: granulation curls in repeated brushstroke whorls around the pores
issues.fix: vary cell size and swirl direction so the surface does not look painted
